Finally, the farmer takes the chicken to the other side, ensuring all three items are safely transported without any conflicts.

1. Take the chicken across, leave it, return.  
2. Take the fox across, bring the chicken back.  
3. Take the grain across, leave it, return.  
4. Take the chicken across.  

This ensures no conflicts occur at any stage.
